runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 applies to new AI contracts **180 days after it is issued**. Contracts that stem from solicitations released 180 days or more after the memo's issuance fall within its scope. The same 180-day mark also governs existing contracts: renewal or extension options exercised on existing deals after that same date are also covered.

The memo does not reach everything. AI acquired as a component of a National Security System sits outside the memo.

The passages give the memo's issuance month as April 2025 but not the exact day, so I can't state the calendar date when coverage begins.

Passage states the memo applies to options to renew or extend exercised after the 180-day date on existing contracts.
Passage states the memorandum does not apply to AI acquired as a component of a National Security System.
